title: Deterministic decision-engine financial validation

tests.name: Independent 10m EUR stress cases, all four hedge ratios
Receivable cash sign and adverse NOK appreciation
Budget/volume/FX/hedge waterfall reconciles across two currencies
Committed volume is unchanged by forecast uncertainty
Forecast cancellation leaves the original hedge alive
Forecast growth does not automatically scale the hedge
Fully hedged fixed notional removes FX payoff sensitivity
Natural opposite flows remain gross without explicit matching consent
Netting requires the same entity, set, currency and due date
Timeline is chronologically sorted and reconciles to book total
Reference is current policy under the same scenario
New-policy rates can be supplied independently of current contracts
Missing hedge quote prevents invented hedged alternatives
NOK-only cash is not assigned a fictitious foreign currency hedge
Importer minimum ratio includes forward points
Exporter downside uses the correct sign
Adverse entered forward can impose a maximum hedge ratio
Exactly 100 percent endpoint is feasible
Impossible limit is not clipped to a feasible answer
Hedge-independent scenario returns all feasible or none
Common-FX threshold reproduces the direct cash book boundary
Common shock gives exporter lower bound and fully hedged flat case
Local and FX shocks include their interaction
100 percent initial-unit hedge cancels FX only for unchanged local value
Same-holdings currency benchmark isolates policy difference
Portfolio waterfall reconciles across currencies and row overrides
Unmapped imported asset class is disclosed as held constant
Long EUR proxy loses on NOK appreciation and is labelled proxy
Stressed forward and explicit discount factor determine the mark
Continuous discount uses actual days over 365 and rejects expired positions
Threshold, posted collateral, haircut and minimum transfer reconcile
Opposite positions net only inside the same entity and CSA
Missing CSA terms are unknown, not a zero-threshold margin assumption
Release in one CSA does not fund another CSA automatically
Blank amount, hedge share and required forward are never zero
Scenario blanks and invalid boundaries reject stale calculations
Extreme numerical overflow returns no valid monetary result
Invalid dates and blank collateral assumptions cannot become valid marks
Inputs remain unchanged and repeated results are deterministic

limits: Same-session implementation verification, not external model validation.
Deterministic scenario arithmetic is tested; no probabilities, forecast superiority, live prices, legal netting enforceability or executable trading strategy are certified.
The historical prediction model has its own retained validation and remains separate.
